home.title: Credit History
home.description: Portable credit history built on ACTA verifiable credentials. Product skeleton — nothing implemented yet.
home.subtitle: Own, manage, and share your verifiable credit reputation. Port your financial history securely without relying on centralized credit bureaus.
home.shareDesc: Select credit credentials and create a secure, verifiable link to share with lenders.
home.shareFeatures: Supports custom expiration dates and dynamic on-chain verification checks.
home.vaultDesc: View your scores, repayment history, and verify identity credentials in your personal vault.
home.vaultFeatures: Direct cryptographic vault interactions and real-time did:stellar resolver.
home.techStack: Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4.
